digest.component_or_area: test observability and editor fixture setup
propositions: CPython ThreadingHTTPServer construction on macOS synchronously calls socket.getfqdn(127.0.0.1), performing an unnecessary reverse DNS lookup that blocks for ~35 seconds

test_server_binds_loopback_only exhibits a consistent 35-second setup duration in Gerrit Verify runs that is not reproducible in focused local runs or explained by worker starvation, tmp_path creation, or TCP bind latency

Nested timing instrumentation around editor fixture setup, server constructor, TCP bind, and getfqdn calls must discriminate which operation owns the 35-second delay without changing test behavior or breaking on environments outside CI

Organic macOS CI observation confirmed that 35 seconds is spent in socket.getfqdn and ThreadingHTTPServer constructor, ruling out other hypotheses and establishing a performance regression against the operator requirement that individual tests remain negligible
